sets.title: McKay Residence
sets.blurb: Class-issued two-storey house with basement and garage, substantially modified: plan widened 4 ft, fireplace relocated, staircase redesigned to meet the OBC.
sets.detail: Two-storey house with basement and garage. The class-issued project was substantially modified. The plan was widened 4 ft to the left and the fireplace relocated, so the dining area seats a 6 to 8 person table and the living room is more comfortable. The staircase was redesigned to meet the OBC, as the original did not comply. The cover sheet carries the OBC compliance package and SB-12 energy summary.

sets.title: Wellington Place
sets.blurb: Existing and demolition plans and the proposed ground and second floors. The second-floor apartments were designed entirely by Steven.
sets.detail: Drawing set for Wellington Place, with existing and demolition plans and the proposed ground and second floors. The second-floor apartments were designed entirely by Steven. Views on the sheets carry their own scales, so the measure tool asks which one applies.

sets.title: Refrigerated Food Storage and Distribution Facility
sets.blurb: Plans, section, elevations, wall sections and details for a refrigerated food storage and distribution facility.

sets.title: Administration Building
sets.blurb: Plans, elevations, wall sections, stair details and assembly types. The precast panels are built from custom reveal families in Revit.
sets.detail: Plans, elevations, wall sections, stair details and assembly types for an administration building. The precast panels, with chamfered edges and sealant joints, are built from custom reveal families in Revit.

sets.title: Shoreline House
sets.blurb: Hand-drafted permit-style set for a one-storey house with basement, submitted April 2023. Scans cleaned, drawn content unaltered; scaling not offered.
sets.detail: Hand-drafted permit-style set for a one-storey house with basement, submitted April 2023: cover with OBC and SB-12 package, notes, assemblies, schedules, site and grade plan, plans, elevations, section, kitchen elevation, and sill, eave and stair details. The scans are cleaned (creases and shadows flattened, paper whitened); the drawn content is unaltered. Scaling is not offered on this set.

sets.title: Second Floor Pantry
sets.software: Drawn without CAD, with AI assistance
sets.blurb: Concept drawing set for a linen pantry and dry bar, designed by Steven from his own site measurements. Dimensions are to be verified on site before cutting.

sets.title: Warming Hut: Fire and Ice
sets.blurb: Plan, reflected ceiling plan, two elevations and a section of a warming hut sized for a 7'-0" x 14'-0" raft, on the Warming Huts competition brief, Winnipeg, MB. Each drawing has its own scale bar.

sets.title: Muskoka Cottage: The Treehouse
sets.blurb: Site plan, group plan, four floor plans, two elevations and three sections of a four-building lake cottage in Muskoka, ON, with a table of room areas. Each drawing has a scale bar.
